name: Orders of Tamera
description: The Seeds of Life: • Blessing of Nature. The pilgrim gains a +1d4 bonus to Animal Handling and Nature checks, as well as checks associated with farming and agriculture for one year. The Sons of Tamera: • Blessing of Health. For one year, the pilgrim is resilient in the face of death, requiring four failed death saving throws, instead of the usual three, to meet their end. The Scribes: • Blessing of Inspiration. Once within the year, the pilgrim can invoke a moment of divine clarity, granting them advantage on a single attack roll, saving throw, or skill check. This blessing expires after one use. The Enlightened: • Blessing of Light. After every long rest, the pilgrim gains temporary hit points equal to their character level for one year.
